meta.title: Build from 50 / 25 / 10 / 5
meta.summary: SAMPLE 35% of 2,000: three tenths plus a 5% chunk.

success.message:
Session complete. Percents are Lego: 50, 25, 10, 5.

SAMPLE: 35% of 2,000=700, 15% of 800=120.

start.message:
SAMPLE: 35% of 2,000. You do not need a 35% button.

How do you chunk it?

choices.label: Call it about half because 35 is close to 50

wrong_start_thirty_five.message:
35% is 35 per hundred, not one thirty-fifth. Chunk from 10% and 5%.

Return to the chunks.

wrong_start_half.message:
Half would be 1,000 — way high. 35% is three tenths plus 5%.

Return to the chunks.

add.message:
10% of 2,000 is 200. 5% is 100.

Three tenths plus 5%?

wrong_add_600.message:
Three tenths are 600. 35% still needs the 5% (100).

Revisit the add.

wrong_add_500.message:
25%+10%=35% would be 500+200=700, same answer if you keep both chunks.

Revisit the add.

wrong_check_80.message:
15% needs the extra 5% (40). 80+40=120.

Try the check again.

wrong_check_200.message:
25% would be 200. This is 15% → 120.

Try the check again.
